additionalDocuments.label: Silver Stone Moonlight engineering set · Toumeh mirror

review.gallery: The official road-level image shows the Moonlight tower. Eight native brochure renders show the building, amenities and interiors. Shared Moonlight and Twilight visuals were excluded.
review.location: Physical page 7 shows Moonlight in Al Jaddaf Waterfront. Its original QR resolves to the named project, with the place coordinates taken from the Google Maps pin data. Published website time ranges stay intact and brochure-only figures are identified separately.
review.floorPlans: Fourteen complete apartment drawings and printed total areas matched in the brochure and separate 16-page official plan book. The 1 BR Type 02 suite square footage and Type 07 balcony square metres contain source inconsistencies. The printed totals agree with the corresponding total in the other unit within rounding. Seven whole retail, podium, office and residential floor drawings come from the separately attributed original Silver Stone PDF.

unavailable: The project pin does not establish an entrance coordinate. Separate current unit-specific office or retail area schedules were not established.
